questions.question: When King David brought the ark of God to Jerusalem, who did he say were the only ones allowed to carry it?
When King David and the Levites brought the ark of God into Jerusalem, how did the Levites carry it?

answers.text: On a cart pulled by oxen
On a chariot pulled by horses

questions.question: Because God helped the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant, what did they do?

answers.text: Sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams
Rested seven days beside the road
Set up stones to mark the spot

questions.question: As the ark of the covenant entered the City of David, what did Saul's daughter Michal see from a window?

answers.text: King David weeping beside the ark
King David arguing with the priests
